name: Natsu no Hitoshizuku
source:
The 7th of July, Tanabata Day. 
Every year around this time customers flood the pension house main character runs. Some have become regulars by now, some are new and mysterious.
Can protagonist create summer memories and get into real adult relations this year?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-october-2004-akai-ito.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
7月7日，七夕。
每年这个时候，主人公经营的民宿都会迎来大量客人。有些人如今已是常客，另一些则是神秘的新面孔。
主人公今年能否留下夏日回忆，并发展真正成熟的成人关系？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-october-2004-akai-ito.html]vndbreview[/url]]
